relations.quote: A ring is a set with an addition and a multiplication that obey the usual rules of arithmetic, and the argument needs one because a ring gives the arithmetic of the [arrays](array.md) used here, whose entries are added and multiplied.
Residue rings are the arithmetic of the [fast multiplication of Schönhage and Strassen](schonhage-strassen.md).
